dialogues.speaker: Maymunah
dialogues.text: It's great that we're busy again, but management work is really a giant pain in the... huh? So you made time to visit the Fairgrounds today?

dialogues.speaker: Maymunah
dialogues.text: Yes, it is spacious here, but the number of stalls is limited. After the light in the large tent got fixed, even more people are interested in applying for a stall...

dialogues.speaker: Maymunah
dialogues.text: Nothing is harder than making decisions and arrangements!

dialogues.speaker: Maymunah
dialogues.text: My predecessor must have abandoned me here and fled back to Sumeru because they just couldn't take it anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Maymunah
dialogues.text: Still, anything is hard when you're first starting. If I just take time to think and train my brain... I'm taking care of these Fairgrounds in her stead to prove...

dialogues.speaker: Maymunah
dialogues.text: To prove that things would have been better, if only she had spent more time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh? So I did more harm than help?

dialogues.speaker: Maymunah
dialogues.text: Hehe, just joking, just joking! Thanks for fixing the Crystal Light, I mean it.

dialogues.speaker: Maymunah
dialogues.text: Hehe... As part of your reward, shouldn't you see the fruits of your labor? Now that it's lively again, you should come visit more!

dialogues.speaker: Maymunah
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm just rambling! Ignore my nonsense, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Maymunah
dialogues.text: Though now that I think about it... It's only thanks to your fixing the Crystal Light that I even have the opportunity for such worries...
